rounding_convention: decimal.Decimal throughout; ROUND_HALF_UP to the nearest whole dollar applied per period, with the rounded carrying amount carried forward. Issue price from the exact PV formula rounded once (cross-checked against 5-decimal PV table factors 0.88849 / 3.71710 -- both give the same dollar). Final period plugs the residual premium. August 31 accrual = period-2 row x 2/6, amortization line as the balancing figure.

answers.value: Current liability. The bonds mature December 31, Year 2 -- within one year of the December 31, Year 1 balance sheet date -- so the obligation is no longer long-term. It is presented at its net carrying amount of $183,445, i.e. Bonds payable $180,000 plus unamortized premium $3,445; the premium is reported as a direct addition to (not separate from) bonds payable.

Part A - first semiannual interest payment and premium amortization
Part A - period-end adjusting entry (2/6 of the period-2 row)
Part A - repayment of principal at maturity (interest entry excluded)
Part B - issue $240,000 7% bonds at par between interest dates, plus accrued interest
Part B - first semiannual cash interest payment (expense for 3 months outstanding)

notes: Part A: n=4 semiannual periods at i=3%; cash interest $7,200/period. Part B follows the course textbook (ch.16 Demo 16-2b) for bonds sold between interest dates: accrued interest at the stated rate is credited to Interest Payable at issuance, and at the first June 30 payment interest expense is recognized only for the 3 months the bonds were outstanding. Part h is qualitative and is returned as a text value.
